name: health-export-mcp
description: Query 194 Apple Health/HealthKit metrics from any MCP agent: 16 read-only tools, 22 prompts, zero dependencies, local stdio. The open-source server for the MetricBridge iOS app.
longDescription: An open-source, zero-dependency MCP server that turns your Apple Health export into 16 query tools any AI agent can call in natural language. Tracks HRV, sleep, resting heart rate, steps, workouts, VO₂ max, and 180+ more metrics, all local-first with no developer server in the path.
